name: Vabicaserin
summary: Vabicaserin (codenamed SCA-136) is an investigational antipsychotic and anorectic that was under development by Wyeth. As of 2010, it is no longer in clinical trials for the treatment of psychosis. It was also under investigation as an antidepressant, but this indication was dropped as well.

pharmacology.text: Vabicaserin acts as a selective 5-HT2C receptor full agonist (Ki = 3 nM; EC50 = 8 nM; IA = 100% (relative to 5-HT)) and 5-HT2B receptor antagonist (IC50 = 29 nM). It is also a very weak antagonist at the 5-HT2A receptor (IC50 = 1,650 nM), though this action is not clinically significant.
